title: CSN starts review of bids for cement business
content: Brazil: Steelmaker CSN announced on 10 August 2026 that it had begun to review binding bids for a potential full divestment of its cement business CSN Cimentos. It was earlier reported that the sale could fetch more than US$2bn, with China-based Huaxin Cement and a consortium of Votorantim Cimentos and Italy-founded Cementir Holding among the leading contenders.

title: Azerbaijan reports rise in clinker production in first half of 2026 financial year
content: Azerbaijan: The State Statistics Committee recorded cement production of 1.85Mt in the first half of 2026, down by 4% year-on-year. Meanwhile, clinker production rose by 3%, to 1.91Mt.
